about.title: We're not just an agency for hire —
about.titleHighlight: we're a growth partner who gets hands-on
about.body: In today's competitive market, siloed marketing efforts can't deliver sustainable results. At Cast a Charm, we blend deep strategy, data, and top-tier creativity to push your business toward industry leadership.

feature1.title: Full-Funnel Growth
feature1.body: We cover every stage — from the first brand impression to closing the sale and driving repeat purchases.

feature2.title: Data-Driven & Creative
feature2.body: Decisions backed by real numbers, paired with scroll-stopping creative ideas.

panel.footerBody: A hands-on team that feels like an in-house marketing department for your company.

services.title: 9 Core Services to Unlock Every Dimension of Growth
services.subtitle: Pick a service à la carte, or combine all 9 for our most powerful results.

items.title: Digital Strategy & Planning
items.body: We build the strategic blueprint — competitor analysis and market positioning for a lasting edge.

items.title: Content & Creative Production
items.body: Short-form video for Reels/TikTok, scroll-stopping ad graphics, and storytelling content that turns viewers into loyal fans.

items.title: Performance Marketing & Ads
items.body: Precision ad campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Google Ads with A/B testing and retargeting to maximize ROAS.

items.title: Organic Traffic & SEO
items.body: Rank on Google's first page through keyword research, technical SEO, and quality content for sustainable free traffic.

items.title: Social Media Management
items.body: End-to-end page management, content calendars, engagement-driving posts, and a 24/7 chat team closing sales.

items.title: Website & MarTech Solutions
items.body: Fast landing pages and e-commerce sites, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and full CRM integration.

items.title: Influencer & KOL Marketing Management
items.body: Sourcing and matching influencers, celebrities, and micro & macro KOLs to your target audience, with contract management and end-to-end sales tracking.

items.title: Product & Packaging Design
items.body: Packaging and product design that stands out on shelf, reinforces brand identity, and adds marketing value.

items.title: Event & Brand Activation
items.body: Launch events, exhibition booths, and roadshows that connect customers with your brand in person.
